services.name: School Tours
services.desc: Closed on Sunday & Monday Admin office: Tuesday-Friday, Noon-5pm Gallery: Tuesday-Saturday, Noon-5pm Box office: Tuesday-Friday, 1-4pm At the Yukon Arts Centre Public Art Gallery, we bring learning to life through the visual arts. Our guided school tours will take you through our exhibitions with the aim of nurturing the next generation of artists and art lovers by introducing tools to foster artistic literacy and encouraging students to think critically about visual images. Opening up the world of art allows young people to find meaning in creative expression. And of course, pleasure! Back in the classroom, students will discover a new connection to their culture, history and environments.
